programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: The Smurfs

King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Happy New Year… Again!
programme.desc: Masha decides celebrating New Year once is not enough and goes to mysterious China, where dragons dance, gardens bloom and many, many more interesting things are happening!

programme.title: Like Cat And Mouse
programme.desc: Alert! Bear's fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: At Your Service
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Bon Appétit
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear's distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Once In A Year
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.

programme.title: Prances With Wolves
programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Around the world in one day
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it's Masha's turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Terrible Power
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Sonic Underground
programme.desc: Robotnik announces that he will marry Queen Aleena in a plot to become the king of Mobius.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Outraged by a new hit song written about Sonic, Robotnik outlaws music on Mobius then takes pop star, Catty Carlisle captive. With his MD (Music Destroyer) Robot, Robotnik terrorizes the music loving Mobius population till Sonic rescues Catty.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Sonic rescues Lucas, a rival of Robotnik's, from Robotnik's dungeons. But Robotnik will do anything to keep Lucas from finding his lost love, Lucinda, including proposing to her himself.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Big Griz, leader of a group of biker-bear rebels, mistakes Scratch and Grounder for Sonic and Tails, and teams up with S and G to attack the real Sonic and Tails.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Tails gets a megadose of Robotniks growth gas and grows quickly to monstrous proportions, eating everything in sight and accidentally terrorizing the countryside.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home, Robotnik finds out, and creates a robot fox family which poses as Tails' long lost parents. Sonic leaves Tails with the fox family, but finally realizes they're robots and rescues Tails.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: An elderly, out of shape, overweight superhero keeps trying to help Sonic battle Dr. Robotnik, and keeps getting him in more jepordy. Sonic helps the old hero regain his self respect and they team up to battle Robotnik's latest scheme.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Sonic turns detective to solve the mystery of his missing Red Sneakers--and just in time to get them back and stop Dr. Robotnik's latest attack on a peaceful Mobius village.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strenghs.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Mobius is suffering a crime spree and all the evidence points to Sonic as the culprit. But the real thief is a lab rat wearing a high-tech vehicle suit who was sent by Robotnik to discredit our hero.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: When Hacker, an adolescent mole computer whiz steals a super-intelligence program from Robotnik's computer, Sonic has to protect him, smashing Grounder to pieces.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Robotnik installs a new "obedience microchip" in Scratch and Grounder and orders them to drill for a rare mineral in a tropical mountain. With his Freezomatic machine, Robotnik covers the mountain in ice and runs a Hermit out of his home.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff "unworthy".

programme.title: Donkey Kong Country The Curse of Kongo Bongo
programme.desc: Everyone in the island receives a mysterious letter. Donkey Kong and Diddy discovers that Kongo Bongo Island is coming to an end which these letters contain a curse that causes the Crystal Coconut to stop working, and could eventually destroy the island.

programme.title: SONIC X Depths of Danger
programme.desc: The President demands the search for Dr. Eggman after Sonic destroys the Egg Fort. Meanwhile, Sonic and his friends are taking a well-deserved vacation where they discover that another Chaos Emerald is nearby.

programme.title: Roblox Rumble Garden Gauntlet
programme.desc: The competition grows and the gamers meet their 7th challenge of the competition. Host Frankie Vu watches as the players get lost in this hectic hedge maze.

programme.title: Roblox Rumble Sweet Escape
programme.desc: The competition is down to the final four! Host Frankie Vu watches as the gamers run through this sugary sweet obstacle course for the chance to become the ultimate gamer.

programme.title: Donkey Kong Country Speed
programme.desc: Krusha gets highly intelligent after being run over by a minecart and turns into the leader of the Kremlings. When Diddy and Dixie are trapped in a runaway mine cart with no brakes, it's up to Donkey Kong and Candy to rescue them.

programme.title: SONIC X The Adventures of Knuckles and Hawk
programme.desc: Knuckles rescues a man named Hawk from ancient ruins. Discovering later that Hawk had discovered a chaos emerald, Knuckles seeks for him once again in Oriental City. There he is confronted by some local thugs Li Yan and the Bruiser Boys.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Humkadam
programme.desc: Humkadam is a first of its kind show on Indian television that presents the complicated dynamics of ‘Saas' and ‘Bahu' in a clutter breaking manner. It tells the story of Tara and Shanti who are two diametrically opposite personalities, stuck in unprecedented situations. Just when they thought life had come to a full stop, is where they had to put their differences aside and start a new journey. Will they become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

programme.title: Armor Monster
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Cubs

This show is a colorful paradise for kids, teeming with adventures around every corner.

programme.desc: A journey to experience the most revered religious sites of India. A spiritual – travel series which unfolds untold stories and takes its viewers on a devotional journey."

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Bharat Ratna The Jewels Of India
programme.desc: Bharat Ratna The Jewels of India is a show that celebrates the recipients of India's highest civilian honour. Through the medium of graphics and information, the show, intends to exhibit hidden unknown and loved stories from lives of these legendary characters.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.desc: Salvatore Cangemi, proprietario di una società di ortofrutta di giorno e magnaccia di notte, viene minacciato dall'apparizione di uno spietato gangster francese chiamato Le Capitaine che vuole unire il crimine organizzato a Milano per ottenere tutti i profitti. Totò non ha intenzione di far parte dell'organizzazione di Le Capitaine, e la loro rivalità causa una sanguinosa guerra tra bande.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: David di Donatello per la miglior regia a Gianni Franciolini grazie a questo Classico interpretato dal celebre Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grandissimo Vittorio De Sica. Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere e coinvolge tre suoi amici in una serie di azioni poco raccomandabili. I quattro furbetti si cacceranno presto nei guai.

programme.title: Camping
programme.desc: Frizzante commedia diretta da Zeffirelli. I giovani fidanzati Tao e Valeria decidono di prendersi una vacanza per sfuggire alla routine, ma i genitori di Valeria, diffidenti verso Tao, insistono che il fratello di lei, Nino, li accompagni. Dopo un viaggio movimentato in sidecar, arrivano in un campeggio frequentato da turisti tedeschi, affascinati dalla bellezza di Valeria.

programme.title: Le cameriere
programme.desc: Gabriella, cameriera per una famiglia romana, indossa un gioiello della signora per cui lavora ad una festa. Senza accorgersene viene derubata da un affascinante uomo di cui la ragazza non ricorda il nome. Dopo essere stata denunciata per furto, insieme alle sue amiche, darà la caccia al misterioso seduttore per dimostrare la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Domenica d'agosto
programme.desc: Grande classico con Marcello Mastroianni. Dalla calda città di Roma una folla variegata, di ogni estrazione sociale, si muove con mezzi diversi verso il lido di Ostia. C'è chi va al mare in bicicletta, chi, con la propria auto, ci porta tutta la famiglia, chi finge di essere ricco per conquistare l'amore dei suoi sogni e così via. È l'Italia del 7 agosto 1949, festa di San Gaetano.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
programme.desc: Irresistibile commedia interpretata dal grande Totò, simbolo della comicità, e dal divertentissimo Peppino De Filippo. Il Cavalier Vignarello e il ragionier Caprioli, ricoverati in una clinica per malattie mentali, si rivolgono al Direttore sostenendo di trovarsi lì per equivoco e a causa delle manie dei rispettivi familiari. Riescono a convincerlo e accade qualcosa di incredibile.

programme.title: Casanova 70
programme.desc: Andrea, ufficiale della Nato, è colpito da un`ossessione che lo spinge a compiere azioni rischiose per le sue conquiste galanti. Lo psicanalista, ascoltato il racconto delle sue avventure, gli rimprovera l`eccessiva frenesia amorosa e gli consiglia una vacanza di riposo in montagna. Ma anche in vacanza Andrea non perde il vizio di correre dietro alle donne...

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: A Beecham House, una casa di riposo per cantanti lirici e musicisti immersa nella campagna inglese, si prepara come ogni anno il grande spettacolo per l'anniversario della nascita di Giuseppe Verdi. Tutti gli artisti residenti tornano sulla scena per raccogliere fondi per mantenere Beecham e, tra gorgheggi e capricci, rinascono ansie da prima donna, rivalità tra istrioni, isterismi. Qualcuno si sente male, qualcuno beve di nascosto, qualcuno rifiuta di cantare. E, ad aumentare la confusione, arriva una nuova pensionante: la diva della lirica Jean Horton, che ritrova Reggie, Wilf e Cissy, gli altri componenti di un quartetto leggendario. Reggie è il suo ex marito e il quartetto si sciolse quando divorziarono.

programme.title: Preludio alla guerra
programme.desc: Il film si apre su una parata delle forze armate americane. La voce narrante chiede «Perché gli americani sono in marcia?». Risponde elencando una serie di teatri di guerra (Pearl Harbor, Gran Bretagna, Francia, Cina, Cecoslovacchia, Norvegia, Paesi Bassi, Polonia, Grecia, Belgio, Albania, Jugoslavia, Russia), mentre vengono mostrate immagini di guerra e distruzione.

programme.title: Il fantasma galante
programme.desc: Un signorotto scozzese durante il secolo XVIII muore in una battaglia codarmente. Epperò è condannato a vagare in spirito nell'avito castello fintanto che non incontrerà un discendente della famiglia nemica e non lo umilierà. Attualmente il castello è in rovina e il proprietario, giovane ed ultimo erede della famiglia scozzese, carico di debiti non riesce a vendere la storica bicocca. Ma un giorno una graziosa americana si invaghisce del castello (e più forse del proprietario) e convince i propri genitori a farne l'acquisto, il castello viene demolito e portato in America. Durante la traversata il fantasma, come suo dovere, compare sul transatlantico ed all'arrivo del piroscafo i giornali levano il più alto scalpore intorno al fatto straordinario.

programme.title: The Congress
programme.desc: Robin Wright, una ormai stanca e invecchiata diva hollywoodiana, accetta un ultimo ruolo offertole dalla major Miramount, che le propone di comprare la sua identità cinematografica: attraverso un body scanner verrà creato un alias a sua immagine da utilizzare sullo schermo al posto suo, rendendola così protagonista di tutti i film che in passato lei stessa aveva rifiutato. In cambio Robin riceverà un'ingente somma di denaro e gli studios le promettono di mantenere il suo personaggio giovane per l'eternità.

programme.title: La canzone più triste del mondo
programme.desc: Durante la Grande Depressione, nella cittadina di Winnipeg, una baronessa indice un concorso per trovare la canzone più triste del mondo. Musicisti da tutto il mondo accorreranno per vincere il primo premio: 25 mila dollari. Un musical grottesco e fantastico, diretto da un grande regista, purtroppo poco conosciuto in Italia: Guy Maddin.

Ambientato nel mondo delle bande di motociclisti criminali, il film segue le vicende del nuovo capo di una gang di motociclisti costretto a tradire il proprio superiore per salvare la vita del fratello.

programme.title: Kiss Daddy Goodnight IT
programme.desc: Laura è la classica brava ragazza dalla faccia angelica. Di notte però la sua personalità cambia aspetto e diventa una cacciatrice senza scrupoli di uomini di mezza età, vittime predestinate del suo malvagio gioco.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.

programme.title: Il cagnaccio dei Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes e l'assistente Watson vengono ingaggiati a indagare sugli omicidi della famiglia di nobili, i Baskerville, a cui appare un cane intento ad azzannare gli eredi.

programme.title: Lo smemorato di Collegno
programme.desc: Un uomo in ospedale soffre di amnesia. Dopo aver visto la sua foto sul giornale, due signore affermano che è il loro marito. L'uomo viene portato in tribunale con l'accusa di essere un famoso ladro, il signor LoBianco.

programme.title: Buried alive
programme.desc: Un gruppo di ragazzi risveglia un'antica maledizione in una casa isolata. La vendetta di una donna sepolta viva si scatena. Nessuno è al sicuro.

programme.title: Trailer La casa del Diavolo
programme.sub-title: Hansel e Gretel e La Strega Della Foresta Nera

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Tre amici trovano milioni di dollari nascosti nel bosco, ma presto scoprono che appartengono a un criminale pericoloso. L'avidità e la paura trasformano il loro legame in un conflitto mortale, mentre cercano di sopravvivere alla furia del legittimo proprietario.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: Natale a Greenpine Grove
programme.desc: Una giovane donna partecipa a un concorso di decorazione dell'albero di Natale per onorare la memoria di sua madre, solo per scoprire che alla competizione partecipano anche il suo fidanzato del liceo, recentemente vedovo, e la sua adorabile figlia di 10 anni.

programme.title: Un Casanova a Natale
programme.desc: Elise è una podcaster alla ricerca di contenuti natalizi accattivanti quando accetta di aiutare Daniyal. I due si affannano per organizzare il Natale più bello di sempre.

programme.title: Io e Mr. Christmas
programme.desc: Zoe Deans lascia la grande agenzia per aprire la propria attività, ma ha bisogno di un cliente importante per farsi notare. Decide di rappresentare un concorrente al concorso natalizio Mr. Christmas, trasformando l'evento in una grande occasione pubblicitaria. Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: Un Natale a lume di candela
programme.desc: Juliet propone al suo capo delle candele natalizie per ottenere una promozione e chiede aiuto a Tom, proprietario di un negozio di candele. All'inizio lui rifiuta, ma poi accetta quando capisce che quei soldi aiuteranno a realizzare il desiderio natalizio di sua figlia.

programme.title: Come in un film di Natale
programme.desc: Una cinica stacanovista preferisce trascorre le feste a Bali lavorando, invece di stare con la famiglia. L'aereo su cui viaggia è però costretto a un atterraggio d'emergenza e la donna si ritrova suo malgrado in una gelida cittadina in Colorado.

programme.title: Il gioco della follia
programme.desc: Una casalinga disperata scopre che suo marito ha una relazione e rapisce l'ignara amante, ma ciò che inizia come uno scherzo si trasforma rapidamente fuori controllo.

programme.title: Complotto fatale
programme.desc: Olivia fatica a distinguere la verità dalla finzione dopo che sua figlia scompare misteriosamente durante un campeggio con i nuovi vicini.

programme.title: Fama da assassino
programme.desc: Un'esperta di relazioni pubbliche si vanta del suo basso profilo e della sua reputazione. Tuttavia, rischia entrambi per aiutare una stella d'azione in declino, che è anche il suo amore del college, dopo che lui è accusato di aver ucciso la sua ex-moglie.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Dopo la scoperta da parte di Allison e Matt di un oscuro segreto che riguarda il matrimonio di un loro amico, Allison e Devin vengono coinvolti in una indagine sorprendente. La poesia scirtta da Mariah preoccupa la sua insegnante.

programme.title: Wedding Wonderland
programme.desc: When family conflicts arise between happy couple Hallie and Lucas during the week before their big day, their plans for a breezy wedding in the tropics take a turn and their love is tested when they are forced to put on a small-town winter wedding in the snow.

programme.title: Inaspettate passioni
programme.desc: Dopo una pesante separazione, la giornalista Dana Willingham si ritrova sola e bloccata in un ritiro di yoga per coppie, mentre l'evento più importante della sua carriera sta accadendo lontano. E non le piace nemmeno lo yoga!

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è una wedding planner di successo e molto determinata che vive in una grande città. Quando il padre le chiede di aiutarlo nel ristorante di famiglia, lei torna volentieri nella sua accogliente città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: L'anello perfetto
programme.desc: Insegnante d'arte disoccupata, Allie deve accettare un lavoro con la Squadra dei Babbi Natale per aiutare un ricco vedovo e le sue due adorabili figlie a ritrovare la magia del Natale.

programme.title: Due perfetti rivali
programme.desc: In un sobborgo di Chicago, le due pizzerie Romanos e Juliatos si contendono da anni la clientela in città.

programme.title: The Fighters
programme.desc: Tra i suoi amici e l'azienda di famiglia, l'estate di Arnaud sembra destinata a essere tranquilla. Tranquilla fino a quando non incontra Madeleine, bella quanto brusca, una solida massa di muscoli tesi e profezie apocalittiche.

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: Sposami a Natale
programme.desc: Durante i preparativi per una cerimonia natalizia molto importante e sofisticata, Madaline Krug, un'organizzatrice di matrimoni, si innamora inaspettatamente del fratello della sposa.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Solo per lestate
programme.desc: Cercando di eludere gli sforzi delle loro nonne per organizzare matrimoni, due ex innamorati d'infanzia fingono di tornare insieme per l'estate.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Dolce settembre
programme.desc: Dopo che Rebecca è scappata dal suo ex, esce a bere qualcosa e incontra Bruno, un operatore telefonico.

programme.title: Per amore di Valerie
programme.desc: Florian e Valerie lavorano nello stesso albergo. Florian è innamorato di Valerie.

programme.title: Viaggio sul Kilimangiaro
programme.desc: Un padre, una figlia e tre vite spezzate si rigenerano lungo l'ascesa al Kilimangiaro.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: Dopo essere rimasto vedovo, Frank Fogle intraprende a malincuore un viaggio per onorare l'ultimo desiderio della moglie di spargere le sue ceneri in un lago remoto della natia Irlanda, promettendo di portare con sé il figlio Sean, da lui allontanato. Quando Sean esce di prigione, l'ultima cosa che ha in mente è un viaggio all'estero con il padre alienato. Quello di cui ha bisogno è un nuovo inizio in California. Ma quando i suoi piani di viaggio vanno a monte, accetta con riluttanza la proposta del padre in cambio di un biglietto per la West Coast e della promessa di non rivedersi mai più. Tra una sconcertante veglia irlandese, il riaffiorare di una vecchia fiamma, il rimorchio di una bella autostoppista e un sacco di questioni irrisolte, il viaggio diventa un po' più di quanto padre e figlio avessero previsto.

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Gianni e Maretta, che hanno vissuto insieme per tre anni, decidono di sposarsi. Nonostante essi conducano una vita agiata, il matrimonio si rivela per Gianni una situazione insopportabile. Maretta tenta ogni cosa per salvare l'unione, ma si scontra col carattere frivolo e superficiale del marito. Di reciproco accordo decidono così di tornare a vivere da amanti come avevano fatto prima di sposarsi. Una scappatoia che entrambi ritengono necessaria per salvare il salvabile.

programme.title: Be Kind Rewind
programme.desc: Un negozio di vhs rischia di chiudere, per via dello strapotere dei dvd. Per risolvere alcuni problemi, il proprietario della videoteca ne affida temporaneamente la gestione ad un commesso. Durante l'assenza del proprietario, tutte le videocassette si smagnetizzano. Il commesso ed un suo amico decidono quindi di realizzare una versione amatoriale di alcuni dei film presenti nel negozio, per evitarne il fallimento.

programme.title: La nostra vacanza in Scozia
programme.desc: Doug, Abi e i loro tre ragazzi, viaggiano verso le highlands scozzesi per la festa di compleanno di Gordie, il padre dell'uomo. Sin da subito appare chiaro che, per mantenere al sicuro un segreto dal resto dei parenti, Doug ed Abi devono stare attenti a cosa dicono i loro figli…

programme.title: Motel Woodstock
programme.desc: Il film racconta la storia di Tiber, un uomo comune che gestiva assieme ai genitori un motel, tenendo nascosta la propria omosessualità. Tiber fu l'uomo che riuscì a trovare il luogo adatto e le licenze necessarie per dar vita ad uno degli eventi che hanno segnato la storia della musica, del costume e non solo, il Festival di Woodstock.

programme.title: Giuramento
programme.desc: A causa delle disastrose condizioni economiche in cui versano, Salvatore e Concetta non si possono sposare, né possono far operare la madre di lei per toglierle la cecità. per sopperire alla necessità, la donna decide di partire con il fratello Nino alla volta degli Stati Uniti per andare a chiedere ad una ricca zia. prima di partire Concetta giura eterna fedeltà a Salvatore. Ma dopo un po' di tempo l'uomo non avrà più notizie di lei. partirà cosi a sua volta per gli Stati Uniti, dove scoprirà che Concetta non ha rispettato il patto, sposandosi con un boss mafioso.

programme.title: Tutte Pazze Per Charlie
programme.desc: A una festa, Chuck, dieci anni, non rispetta la regola del gioco della bottiglia, rifiutandosi di baciare una ragazza. Determinata a non far trovare a Chuck il vero amore, questa, per vendetta, gli getta il malocchio. Vent'anni dopo Chuck è un dentista che non riesce ad avere una relazione stabile.

programme.title: La cosa più dolce
programme.desc: Quando si tratta di uscire con un uomo, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) ha una regola d'oro: evitare l'uomo giusto e concentrarsi su quello del momento. Questo, fino a quando non conosce inaspettatamente Peter (Thomas Jane), che il giorno dopo scompare. Lei sa solo che deve presenziare a un matrimonio, ma non sa che è il suo. Insieme alla migliore amica Courtney (Christina Applegate), Christina decide di infrangere le regole e andarlo a cercare, imbattendosi in varie e divertenti disavventure durante il viaggio. Connubio di un film on the road, umorismo e ricerca dell'uomo perfetto, The Sweetest Thing è una commedia romantica piuttosto amara, una svolta nuova sulla ricerca dell'amore.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Warren Beatty e Dustin Hoffman trovano l'avventura, l'amore e il divertimento nella strada verso ISHTAR.

programme.title: Scuola Di Geni
programme.desc: Quando tre studenti geni si uniscono, può capitare di tutto. Chris (Val Kilmer) trasforma il dormitorio in una pista di pattinaggio, smonta e rimonta un auto nella sua stanza e organizza un beach party nell'auditorium con una laguna e bellezze al bagno.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Capo
programme.desc: Bloccato dalla neve in Pennsylvania, per il suo rituale servizio sul “giorno della marmotta”, il metereologo televisivo Phil Connors (Bill Murray) si ritrova fermo nel tempo, costretto a rivivere il 2 febbraio.

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Il fidanzamento
programme.desc: La madre di Mirella vuole che Luigi sposi sua figlia, ma lui non vuole rinunciare al ruolo di fidanzato.

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Pane, burro e marmellata
programme.desc: Bruno, lasciato dalla moglie, trova rifugio da tre donne e diventa il sultano del loro piccolo harem

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Scuola di mostri
programme.desc: Un giovane gruppo di fanatici dei mostri tenta di salvare la propria città natale dal Conte Dracula e dai suoi mostri.

programme.title: Sogno Di Una Notte Di Mezza Eta'
programme.desc: Daniel è felicemente sposato con sua moglie, ma ha due problemi: la sua fervida fantasia e il suo miglior amico Patrick, che durante una cena presenta agli amici la sua giovane “fiamma”, questo porterà Daniel a sognare ad occhi aperti e non distinguere la realtà dalla fantasia.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Un incauto fattorino consegna inavvertitamente all'indirizzo sbagliato un pacco contenente panetti di cocaina occultati.

programme.title: Scappa, scappa... poi ti prendo!
programme.desc: In questa parodia di film blaxploitation, un aspirante eroe nero riunisce ex eroi neri degli anni '70 per aiutarlo a vendicarsi di Mr. Big.

programme.title: I visitatori alla conquista dell'America
programme.desc: Per porre fine alla Guerra dei Cent' anni il duca de Malfete va in Inghilterra per sposare una giovane principessa inglese. Ma le cose non vanno come sperato.

programme.title: Tentazioni Irresistibili
programme.desc: Tre uomini devono affrontare la loro dipendenza dal sesso e continuare a vivere una vita normale in una New York dalle mille tentazioni. Con Mark Ruffalo e Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Irma Vep
programme.desc: Maggie Cheung, star del cinema d'arti marziali di Hong Kong, arriva a Parigi per recitare nel remake di un celebre serial del cinema muto francese, I vampiri di Louis Feuillade.

programme.title: Uno chef in corsia
programme.desc: Sul punto di essere promossa come capo dipartimento in un ospedale, Nina vuole istituire un programma di lezioni di cucina dietetica per i pazienti, così decide di convincere un giovane chef promettente a partecipare al progetto.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: All'ultimo sangue
programme.desc: Avvincente film western classico. Un libro paga dell'esercito viene derubato da Billy Gun, uno spietato fuorilegge. L'esercito assume Clive Norton per recuperare il denaro e, per farsi aiutare, salva dalla forca un uomo che disprezza particolarmente Gun, ovvero suo fratello, El Chaleco.

programme.title: I cavalieri del nord ovest
programme.desc: Il capitano Nathan Brittles (John Wayne), ad un passo dalla pensione, prende il comando di un'ultima missione con il compito di fermare un imminente grosso attacco indiano. La sua missione è messa in pericolo dalla presenza, tra le sue truppe, di alcune donne che devono essere evacuate.

programme.title: Execution
programme.desc: Avvincente western italiano. Un cacciatore di taglie, Clips, è da tempo sulle tracce di John Cooler, un anziano bandito sul cui capo pende una taglia di ventimila dollari. John è ricercato anche dal messicano Juarez e dalla sua banda, i quali vogliono impadronirsi di un carico d'oro che il vecchio bandito ha rubato alcuni anni prima all'esercito americano.

programme.title: Adios Cjamango!
programme.desc: Le avventure di Cjamango e Peggy, due giovani sposi proprietari di un ranch che si battono per salvare la propria casa dalle grinfie di una compagnia ferroviaria decisa ad acquistare il loro terreno.

programme.title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
programme.desc: Due uomini stanno andando a Denver City per regolare un conto personale. Uno cerca l'assassino di suo padre, l'altro un ex amico che gli ha rubato l'oro. A loro si unisce una terza persona, un misterioso pistolero.

programme.title: Il tredicesimo è sempre Giuda
programme.desc: Ned Carter sta aspettando con un gruppo di ospiti la sua sposa. Quando notano che al tavolo ci sono esattamente 13 persone, un numero sfortunato, alcuni pensano che sia un cattivo presagio. E infatti, quando arriva la diligenza, la sposa è stata assassinata.

programme.title: Lungo il fiume rosso
programme.desc: Dopo una dura battaglia, il capitano McKane conquista una città californiana e scaccia i coloni messicani. Con l'aiuto del sergente Pardee e di mercenari, McKane impone la sua legge con brutalità. Quando il giudice Ward Young e suo figlio Faron arrivano, sono sconvolti dalla spietata leadership di McKane e giurano di ripristinare l'ordine e giustizia nella città.

programme.title: La rosa gialla del Texas
programme.desc: Jack Slade, cacciatore di taglie e figlio di un famoso uomo di legge, viene incaricato dalla Pinkerton di catturare una banda di rapinatori di treni. Dopo furti e inganni, e la morte del suo amico Turner, Slade giura vendetta e, con Ryan, prepara una trappola mortale per i fuorilegge e le loro complici.

programme.title: Custer eroe del West
programme.desc: L'amore di George Armstrong Custer per le tradizioni eroiche del Calvario e il suo disgusto per l'avvento dell'industrializzazione lo portano al suo destino al Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Queimada
programme.desc: Sull'isola di Queimada, un avventuriero incita una rivolta contro i portoghesi per l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Viva Gringo
programme.desc: Degli emissari peruviani negoziano la pace con gli Incas, ma un bandito li incolpa per il delitto del sovrano.

programme.title: Tutto per tutto
programme.desc: A El Paso, l'indiano Faccia di Rame cerca vendetta contro il ladro Carranza per l'oro rubato.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia
programme.desc: Un professore di storia incrocia casualmente un noto fuorilegge e finisce per guidare la sua banda.

programme.title: Salyut-7
programme.desc: La stazione spaziale sovietica Salyut-7, in orbita attorno alla Terra, va improvvisamente fuori controllo.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Una coppia in viaggio sulla transiberiana dovrà fare i conti con una banda armata di trafficanti.

programme.title: Freelancers
programme.desc: Il figlio di un poliziotto di New York ucciso si unisce alle forze dell'ordine e ne scopre la corruzione.

programme.title: Salyut-7

programme.title: Monstrum

Per provare a calmare la situazione il ventiduenne Jung Jong convince il fidato generale Yun Kyum a rientrare in azione dopo essersi ritirato.

programme.title: Kill Zone Ai Confini Della Giustizia
programme.desc: Dopo aver fatto un raid contro un gangster in un'operazione sotto copertura, il duro poliziotto Kit viene catturato e si risveglia in prigione in Thailandia con una condanna a vita.

programme.title: Kitty the Killer
programme.desc: Mille anni fa un gruppo di uomini creò una scuola per addestrare delle ragazze e trasformarle in spietate assassine. Oggi questo gruppo di spietate killer opera al servizio dell'Agenzia, un'organizzazione che ha interessi in tutto il mondo.

programme.title: Nana 2
programme.desc: La dolce Nana Hachi e quella dall'anima più rock Osaki Nana continuano a vivere sotto lo stesso tetto.

programme.title: Il magico mondo di Oz
programme.desc: Dorothy torna a Oz per aiutare i suoi amici, minacciati da un perfido Giullare, e incontra nuovi compagni nella sua missione.

programme.title: Un Natale al bacio
programme.desc: Dopo un bacio spontaneo, una designer si innamora del fidanzato della sua titolare mentre decora la casa per Natale.

programme.title: Robo-Dog
programme.desc: Tom crea ROBO-Dog per il figlio triste, ma devono affrontare l'avidità del suo ex capo, il sig. Willis.

programme.title: Avventura nello spazio
programme.desc: Negli anni '60, lo scienziato Wilhelm von Huber affronta la sfida spaziale della NASA e uno scimpanzé

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: Nel 1984, al Circolo polare artico, il Kola Superdeep Borehole è il più grande laboratorio segreto dell'URSS, situato a 12 mila metri sotto terra. Pochi mesi dopo l'apertura del sito, gli scienziati registrano voci e urla di origine sconosciuta.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: Un'astronave si schianta nella Norvegia del 709 d.c. A bordo si trova il guerriero umanoide Kainan e, a sua insaputa, il pericoloso Moorwen. Solo, su un pianeta sconosciuto e arretrato, il guerriero deve accordarsi con il re vichingo Rothgar per sconfiggere la temibile creatura.
